**Your role (operator / SDK integrator / evaluator):**

**What failed or took time?** Describe a concrete HTTP 402 / CORS / buyer error in your own words.

**Public, sanitized evidence only (optional):** Origin format, intended method, HTTP status and CORS header NAMES and NONSECRET allow/expose values. Do NOT paste actual PAYMENT-REQUIRED payloads, signed headers, token/cookie values, wallet addresses, transaction hashes or customer data. Do not include private domains, proprietary source or unreleased endpoints.

**What did you attempt?** For example OPTIONS preflight or free local CLI, no payment required. Say whether this was synthetic or on your own authorized public system. No live spending tests are required.

**Would a one-time paid fix/checklist be worth anything to you?** 0 USDC / ~1.5 USDC AI-guided blueprint / ~15+ USDC scoped hands-on investigation / unknown. This is not a binding order; no payment or wallet connection is requested.

**Permission to follow up in the public thread?** yes / no. We cannot promise remediation until an independently agreed scope exists.

Please NEVER post secrets, credentials, keys, OTPs, private payment claims, wallet seed phrases, identifiable customer data or privileged vulnerability details here. Security issues should be reported privately to the affected operator rather than pasted into a public ticket.
